fixes.new:
Chief of Section 1, Operations Division, Tactical Operations Department at the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel at first, later promoted to Colonel. Age 29.
She is the field commander in the battles against the Angels, taking command of operations in place of $$ゲンドウ$$ or $$冬月$$ when they are absent. She burns with a fierce determination to destroy the Angels, though the details remain unclear.
On duty, her strong sense of responsibility makes her strict with herself and others, and she is bold enough to carry out operations that sometimes seem reckless. She is basically cheerful and caring by nature, but she is slovenly in her private life and hardly ever cooks or cleans.
She acts as a guardian figure to $$シンジ$$, letting him live in her apartment, where she lives with the hot-spring penguin $$ペンペン$$, and watching over his growth as someone who understands him, sometimes strict and sometimes gentle. $$アスカ$$ later joins this household as well.
She has known $$リツコ$$ and $$加持$$ since their school days, and was once $$加持$$'s lover.
fixes.reason: addition; mistranslation: addition: Japanese says only that she lives with the hot-spring penguin Pen Pen (温泉ペンギンのペンペンと住む自分のマンション), not that it is her pet; mistranslation: 詳しい事は不明 is 'the details are unknown', not 'the reasons'

fixes.new:
Supreme Commander of the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
While leading $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ in the fight against the Angels, he secretly advances the $$人類補完計画$$ on $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$'s orders.
He is $$シンジ$$'s father, but his uncompromising manner toward his son means their relationship is far from good.
Always cold and severe, he never reveals his true intentions. The one exception is his relationship with $$レイ#pt394$$, with whom he converses and smiles, and for whom he shows open emotion, even rushing to help her when she is endangered during an experiment.
When he visited the grave of his late wife, $$ユイ$$, he had $$シンジ$$ come along as well.
As the fighting continues, he gradually begins to offer words of approval to $$シンジ$$, and $$シンジ$$ is pleased by them. $$レイ#pt394$$, hoping to bring father and son closer together, plans a meal for the two of them, but the incident in which Unit-03 is infiltrated by an Angel becomes the catalyst for their relationship deteriorating beyond repair.
fixes.reason: pronoun/referent: referent: シンジもそれを喜ぶ - it is Shinji who is glad; 'which pleases him' after 'he' = Gendo (both male) reads as Gendo

fixes.new:
The masked persona $$ルルーシュ$$ adopted to hide his true identity.
He first appeared before the public to rescue $$スザク$$, who had been accused of assassinating Clovis, and from then on staged one miracle after another, becoming a symbol of resistance against Britannia.
After the Black Rebellion, Zero vanished for nearly a year while $$ルルーシュ$$'s memories were sealed, but when $$ルルーシュ$$'s memories returned, so did Zero, appearing before the people once more.
From then on, he pulled off even greater feats, single-handedly rescuing comrades about to be executed, arranging for a million Japanese people to go into exile in the Chinese Federation, and founding the United Federation of Nations, and became a leading figure of the anti-Britannia movement.
However, Schneizel's scheming exposed both $$ギアス$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$'s true identity, forcing a break with the Black Knights.
But Zero appeared once more and struck down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, who had by then seized control of the world. In truth, this Zero was $$スザク$$, who had plotted the Zero Requiem together with $$ルルーシュ$$: by having Zero strike down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, all the hatred concentrated upon the Emperor vanished, and the world entered a new era.
From then on, $$スザク$$ carried on $$ルルーシュ$$'s will, devoting the rest of his life to being Zero.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: mistranslation: 百万人の日本人を中華連邦へと亡命させた - Zero had them flee into exile; he did not grant asylum (the Federation would)

fixes.new:
Born to a Britannian noble father and a Japanese mother, she has been a member of the Black Knights since its founding. Age 18.
Energetic and unwilling to lose, she harbors deep anger toward Britannia for conquering her homeland, Japan.
She met Zero during her time in the resistance, and after witnessing the many miracles he brought about, came to trust him more and more. Her exceptional skill piloting Knightmare Frames was soon recognized, and after the Black Knights were formed, she was appointed captain of the Zero Squad, Zero's personal guard. Piloting her crimson signature unit, the Guren Type-02, she charged through the front lines as the Black Knights' ace.
During the Black Rebellion, she pursued the Lancelot to Kamine Island, where she learned that Zero's true identity was $$ルルーシュ$$. She fell into a state of shock for a time, effectively abandoning $$ルルーシュ$$, but her trust in Zero never fully disappeared.
After a year in hiding, she carried out Operation Hien $$フォウ$$ with $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and others to confirm both her own feelings and $$ルルーシュ$$'s true intentions, and succeeded in reviving Zero.
From then on, with skill said to rival that of the Knights of the Round and her beloved Guren, she won victory after victory on the battlefield, but was captured after running out of energy in her fight against $$星刻$$.
Taken prisoner, $$カレン$$ was handed over to $$スザク$$, and remained off the battlefield for a long time until $$咲世子$$ rescued her during the Second Battle of Tokyo.
When Zero, having been driven out of the Black Knights, became $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, she reunited with him at a negotiation and gave him a farewell kiss.
In the final battle, she fought $$スザク$$ to a near-mutual defeat, but ultimately claimed victory. Afterward, though condemned to execution as a traitor, $$カレン$$ witnessed the Zero Requiem unfold before her eyes.
Having come to understand the true intentions of both $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$スザク$$, $$カレン$$ went on to live in the new world $$ルルーシュ$$ had wished for.
fixes.reason: mistranslation (grammar/referent): grammar/meaning: plural subject 'she and her Guren' with 'was captured' made the Guren the one captured; the Japanese subject of 捕縛されてしまう is Kallen alone

fixes.new:
A girl who possesses an immortal body and the 'Code,' a power that grants $$ギアス$$.
Her name, written '$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$,' is pronounced 'C-Two.'
Under a contract to have her own wish fulfilled, she gave $$ルルーシュ$$ the $$ギアス$$ of 'Absolute Obedience' as the price.
During the Black Rebellion, she sinks $$ジェレミア$$'s Siegfried into the sea, prepared for mutual destruction, and escapes. She then goes into hiding to evade pursuit, but a year later, she carries out Operation Hien $$フォウ$$ with $$カレン$$ and others to reclaim Zero, awakening $$ルルーシュ$$'s sealed memories and reviving him as Zero.
The one wish stipulated by their contract was for her to pass on the immortal Code to someone else so that she herself could finally die. She lent $$ルルーシュ$$ her aid only to wait for his $$ギアス$$ to grow strong enough to reach that point.
Before $$ルルーシュ$$ could earn that qualification, Charles offered to grant her wish himself, but $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ refused. To protect $$ルルーシュ$$, and to fulfill her true wish, she sealed away the immortal Code along with her own memories.
Having lost her memories, she reverted to the state she was in before receiving $$ギアス$$, but was revived after being persuaded by Marianne, who had been hiding within $$アーニャ$$, and went with her to Kamine Island. There, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ watched the entire confrontation between Charles and $$ルルーシュ$$ unfold, and in the end rejected Charles and the others.
Afterward, she remained at the side of $$ルルーシュ$$, now Emperor, as his shield, and took part in the final battle as well.
Having witnessed the Zero Requiem through to the end, she set off for parts unknown, carrying with her the memories of her fellow conspirator, $$ルルーシュ$$.
fixes.reason: mistranslation (reversed direction): reversed direction: 自らの望みを叶えるという契約 is C.C. having her wish granted (by Lelouch), not C.C. granting her own wish; その対価として = 'as its price'

fixes.new:
$$ルルーシュ$$'s younger sister, and 87th in line for the Britannian throne. 15 years old.
She was present when their mother Marianne was assassinated and was caught in the crossfire, losing the sight of both eyes and the use of both legs.
She was the very reason $$ルルーシュ$$ fought, but after the Black Rebellion her whereabouts became unknown.
After Zero's return, however, she appeared before $$ルルーシュ$$ again as an imperial princess of Britannia and the new Viceroy of $$エリア１１$$.
Once installed as Viceroy, she held to the conviction that the world could be changed for the gentler, and kept searching for a way for people of different races and values to walk the same path together.
During the Second Battle of Tokyo she was swallowed by the Freya's explosion and went missing, only to reappear as an empress on Schneizel's side, standing in $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$'s way.
At the final battle she resolved to take the sin upon herself and grasped the control switch for the Freya warhead. Her strong will broke through even her father Charles's memory-rewriting $$ギアス$$.
Afterward, moments before her execution as a traitor, she witnessed the Zero Requiem unfold before her eyes. Understanding her brother's true intent at last, $$ナナリー$$ clung to his body and wept as the crowd's voices rose in praise of Zero, the hero who had struck down the evil $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.
fixes.reason: addition; mistranslation: addition: 'puppet' is not in シュナイゼル側の皇帝; mistranslation: 父シャルルの記憶を書き換えるギアス is Charles's Geass that rewrites memories, not a Geass that rewrote Charles's memory

fixes.new:
One of the Knights of the Round, the strongest knights of the Empire -- Knight of Six. 15 years old.
A formidable talent who rose to the rank of Rounds Knight at the youngest age on record. She rarely shows emotion and behaves with a detached calm, though on rare occasions she does things that defy common sense.
She always carries a cell phone and photographs everything she calls a 'memory,' but this was in fact a way of filling in the memories she lost each time Marianne -- $$ルルーシュ$$'s mother, who had entered her mind through a $$ギアス$$ that transfers others' consciousness -- awakened within her. These lost memories never returned even after Marianne was erased.
At the final battle she fought $$ジェレミア$$ as part of Schneizel's forces and destroyed his Sutherland Sieg, but was defeated by the self-destruct attack of the Sutherland J that emerged from within it. From their exchange, $$ジェレミア$$ realized some kind of $$ギアス$$ had been placed on $$アーニャ$$, and his $$ギアス$$ Canceller freed her completely from Marianne.
After the final battle, she was seen at the side of $$ジェレミア$$, who worked at the orange farm.
fixes.reason: pronoun/referent: referent: オレンジ農園で働くジェレミアの傍ら - it is Jeremiah who works at the farm (agrees with pilot 417), not Anya

fixes.new:
$$ルルーシュ$$'s false younger brother.
He possessed a $$ギアス$$ that stopped the perceived time of others, but it carried a major weakness: his own heart stopped while it was in use.
In truth he was a cold-blooded assassin dispatched by the $$ギアス嚮団$$, and kept $$ルルーシュ$$ under surveillance as a member of the $$機密情報局$$.
Although he learned that $$ルルーシュ$$ had regained his memories of $$ゼロ$$, $$ルルーシュ$$, who had obtained information about his origins and upbringing in advance, struck at his psychological weakness and won him over.
He initially harbored strong doubts about $$ルルーシュ$$, who promised to 'give him a future,' but the doubt gradually changed into trust. With nothing else to cling to, $$ロロ$$ came to place blind trust in $$ルルーシュ$$, the only one he could rely on.
That twisted devotion drove him to turn his blade against his former master, $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$, and swelled until he pulled the trigger on $$シャーリー$$, who had known $$ルルーシュ$$'s identity and still tried to help him. In time he even plotted to kill $$ルルーシュ$$'s real sister, $$ナナリー$$, but just then $$ナナリー$$ was swallowed by the blast of $$フレイヤ$$ and went missing.
$$ルルーシュ$$, who lay in the depths of despair from losing $$ナナリー$$, completely denied the existence of $$ロロ$$, whom he had been using all along, yet $$ロロ$$'s trust in $$ルルーシュ$$ never wavered.
He rushed to $$ルルーシュ$$'s aid when the $$黒の騎士団$$ had him cornered, and saved him by using the time-stopping $$ギアス$$ continuously in exchange for his own life.
In the end, he was acknowledged by $$ルルーシュ$$ as his brother, and breathed his last there.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: mistranslation: 監視している is surveillance/monitoring, 'watched over' means protecting

fixes.new:
Second Princess of the $$神聖ブリタニア帝国$$. Age 28.
She once served as Viceroy of $$エリア１１$$, but gave up the post after the $$ブラックリベリオン$$. Since then she had dropped out of sight, and conducted her own investigation to clear the tarnished name of her full-blooded younger sister, $$ユーフェミア$$.
When she infiltrated the $$ギアス嚮団$$, she was told of the plan of $$シャルル$$ and his associates by $$バトレー$$, who happened to be there, but was discovered by $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$ and detained. However, taking advantage of the confusion of the $$黒の騎士団$$'s raid on the Order, she escaped on her own and defeated the $$ジークフリート$$, piloted by $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$, the source of $$ギアス$$.
Afterward she was held aboard the $$イカルガ$$, but joined $$シュナイゼル$$, who boarded the $$イカルガ$$ himself for direct negotiations with the $$黒の騎士団$$. From then on they acted together, but she saw through the true nature of $$シュナイゼル$$ and turned against him.
Later she attempted to assassinate $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, who had defeated $$シュナイゼル$$, together with her former loyal retainer $$ギルフォード$$ and others, but ended up witnessing the conclusion of $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: mistranslation: シャルルらの計画 = the plan of Charles and the others, not 'Charles's plan and more'

fixes.new:
A boy who had been regarded as the reincarnation of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the 'Wings of the Sun.' Estimated age 13.
Orphaned in the great catastrophe eleven years earlier, he had lived on toughly as a street child, joining forces with $$バロン$$ and others in the same situation.
Besides a rare wild instinct, his astonishing eyesight (5.0 or better in both eyes) and outstanding sense of smell, able to tell apart not only body odor but even the scent of infrared rays, well suited the name of wild child.
His personality was straightforward for better or worse, and he was prone to actions that could even be called selfish. He seemed to lack even a shred of team spirit, but was so loyal to his friends that he would brave any danger for them. He boarded $$アクエリオン$$, too, in order to save $$バロン$$, who had been captured by the $$堕天翅$$.
For a while after entering $$エレメント$$ School, he caused frequent trouble through unfamiliar group life and solo play. But through the fighting he learned cooperation and teamwork, and along with that gradually recalled his past lives.
When the crisis of the world's end came after the final battle, he overcame all the friction and clashes up to then, completed the Genesis Union with $$シリウス$$ and $$頭翅#pilot$$, and became a human sacrifice to save the world. At that time he appeared before $$シルヴィア$$ as a spiritual body and gave her a parting kiss and a vow to meet again 12,000 years later.
fixes.reason: mistranslation (number, term): number: 両目共に５．０以上 is 5.0 or more, not 'better than'; mistranslation: 人柱 is a human sacrifice, 'human pillar' does not mean that in English

fixes.new:
A first-squad $$エレメント$$ attending $$エレメント$$ School. Age 16.
Prince of the old $$アリシア#alisia$$ Kingdom and older brother of $$シルヴィア$$. He cherished a rose he had named $$アリシア#alisia$$, composed poems at every opportunity, and lavished affection on everything beautiful. He acknowledged $$麗花$$'s bearing as beautiful and held affection for her. But since he utterly rejected the opposite, the ugly and the barbaric, he clashed constantly with $$アポロ$$, a bundle of wildness. Much of that toward $$アポロ$$, however, also came from frustration at never being able to recall his own past life, and from jealousy of him.
His $$エレメント$$ ability emitted high-speed vibration from his right arm, and by transmitting it to a sword he could produce astonishing cutting power. His hearing also far surpassed that of ordinary people.
Together with his younger sister $$シルヴィア$$, he had on his right arm a wing of the $$天翅$$, deeply tied to his past life, and had always kept it hidden under a wristband. Later, when $$頭翅#pilot$$ invited him to $$アトランディア$$, $$麗花$$ reached out to stop him, but saw the wing and instinctively pulled her hand back. Stunned by that reaction, $$シリウス$$ realized he no longer had a place on the surface world, and fell to the $$天翅$$. But upon learning that $$頭翅#pilot$$, who had guided him, had been using him for $$頭翅#pilot$$'s own ends, he fought alongside $$アポロ$$ and the others again out of anger.
When the crisis of the world's end came after the final battle, he overcame all the friction and clashes up to then, completed the Genesis Union with $$アポロ$$ and $$頭翅#pilot$$, and became a human sacrifice to save the world.
fixes.reason: mistranslation (term): mistranslation: 人柱 is a human sacrifice ('human pillar' does not convey it); same wording as pilot 438
